Metadata.name: Jump Quest
Metadata.content: A classic 2D side-scrolling platformer featuring Pippo, where precision jumping, exploration, and physics-based platform mechanics are at the forefront. The game challenges players with obstacles, hidden secrets, and dynamic enemy encounters. The UI/HUD displays key game data and menus, while customizable keyboard input ensures smooth gameplay.

Game.description: This element encapsulates all major components of the game including mechanics, UI/HUD systems, and input/control systems with a modular and scalable design for further expansion.

Mechanics.Description: Game mechanics cover movement, jumping, combat, and advanced interactions as defined in the game mechanics list.

Mechanic.Name: Basic Horizontal Movement
Mechanic.Description: Processes left/right movement input to update Pippo’s position across the platforming level.
Mechanic.ImplementationDetails: Implemented via key polling of left/right input. Normalizes user inputs into Pippo’s horizontal velocity adjustments while checking for collision boundaries.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if keyPressed("left") then Pippo.velocity.x = -moveSpeed else if keyPressed("right") then Pippo.velocity.x = moveSpeed else Pippo.velocity.x = 0

Mechanic.Name: Jumping
Mechanic.Description: Enables Pippo to perform a physics-based jump for overcoming obstacles and reaching higher platforms.
Mechanic.ImplementationDetails: Checks if Pippo is on the ground; if jump input is active, applies an upward impulse. Incorporates buffering and coyote time for a responsive jump feel.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if keyPressed("space") and Pippo.isOnGround then Pippo.velocity.y = jumpForce

Mechanic.Name: Double Jump
Mechanic.Description: Allows Pippo to initiate a secondary jump mid-air for extra reach and agility.
Mechanic.ImplementationDetails: Tracks the number of available jumps. Resets jump counter upon landing; permits one extra jump when Pippo is airborne.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if Pippo.onGround then Pippo.jumps = 0 if keyPressed("space") then if Pippo.onGround then Pippo.velocity.y = jumpForce Pippo.jumps = 1 else if Pippo.jumps < 2 then Pippo.velocity.y = jumpForce Pippo.jumps++

Mechanic.Name: Wall Jump
Mechanic.Description: Enables Pippo to jump off walls when airborne, expanding vertical traversal options.
Mechanic.ImplementationDetails: Detects contact with a wall on either side. On jump input, applies an upward impulse plus a horizontal push away from the wall. Resets jump counters appropriately on landing.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if (touchingLeftWall or touchingRightWall) and keyPressed("space") then Pippo.velocity.y = jumpForce if touchingLeftWall then Pippo.velocity.x = horizontalPush else if touchingRightWall then Pippo.velocity.x = -horizontalPush

Mechanic.Name: Wall Slide
Mechanic.Description: Slows Pippo’s descent when in contact with a wall to provide extra time for planning jumps.
Mechanic.ImplementationDetails: Checks if Pippo is sliding against a wall while falling. Limits downward velocity to a predefined slide speed and optionally changes Pippo’s animation state.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if (touchingLeftWall and keyPressed("left")) or (touchingRightWall and keyPressed("right")) then if Pippo.velocity.y > slideSpeedLimit then Pippo.velocity.y = slideSpeedLimit

Mechanic.Name: Climbing
Mechanic.Description: Enables vertical movement when overlapping climbable objects like ladders.
Mechanic.ImplementationDetails: Detects collision with climbable surfaces. Disables gravity as long as Pippo remains in climbing mode and allows precise vertical movement via input.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if overlapping(ladder) then Pippo.onLadder = true disableGravity(Pippo) if Pippo.onLadder then if keyPressed("up") then Pippo.velocity.y = -climbSpeed else if keyPressed("down") then Pippo.velocity.y = climbSpeed

Mechanic.Name: Grappling Hook
Mechanic.Description: Allows Pippo to latch onto valid surfaces and swing or pull himself across gaps.
Mechanic.ImplementationDetails: On activation via specific input, performs raycasting to detect valid targets. Disables gravity temporarily, applies directional force, and renders a visual rope effect. Re-enables gravity once the grapple is released or target is reached.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if grappleButtonPressed and not Pippo.isGrappling then target = findGrapplePoint(Pippo.position, aimDirection) if target exists then Pippo.isGrappling = true disableGravity(Pippo) Pippo.velocity = normalize(target - Pippo.position) * grappleSpeed if Pippo.isGrappling then updateRopeLine(Pippo.position, target) if reached(target) or cancelGrapple then Pippo.isGrappling = false enableGravity(Pippo)

Mechanic.Name: Rope Swinging
Mechanic.Description: Enables a swinging motion on a rope or vine using pendulum dynamics.
Mechanic.ImplementationDetails: Upon detecting overlap with a rope, Pippo enters swing mode. The system calculates angular momentum and applies pendulum physics until release input is detected, returning Pippo to normal physics.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if overlapping(ropeEnd) then Pippo.onRope = true disableGravity(Pippo) setSwingParameters(Pippo, ropeAnchor) if Pippo.onRope then updateSwing(Pippo) if releaseInput then Pippo.onRope = false enableGravity(Pippo)

Mechanic.Name: Sliding
Mechanic.Description: Triggers a low-profile slide to pass under obstacles or evade attacks on the ground.
Mechanic.ImplementationDetails: On detection of down input with sufficient horizontal speed while grounded, reduces Pippo’s collider size and applies a burst of horizontal movement; reverts after a fixed duration.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if keyPressed("down") and Pippo.onGround and abs(Pippo.velocity.x) > threshold then Pippo.isSliding = true adjustCollider(Pippo, reducedSize) setVelocity(Pippo, slideSpeed) after(slideDuration): Pippo.isSliding = false restoreCollider(Pippo)

Mechanic.Name: Crouching
Mechanic.Description: Enables Pippo to decrease his collider height to avoid obstacles or drop through platforms.
Mechanic.ImplementationDetails: On down input when grounded, reduces the collider’s height. Optionally, if jump is pressed then temporarily disables collision with one-way platforms.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if keyPressed("down") and Pippo.onGround then Pippo.isCrouching = true adjustCollider(Pippo, halfHeight) if Pippo.isCrouching and keyPressed("space") then disablePlatformCollision(temporary)

Mechanic.Name: Swimming
Mechanic.Description: Alters movement dynamics in water by reducing gravity and increasing drag, simulating liquid resistance.
Mechanic.ImplementationDetails: Detects when Pippo enters water zones. Modifies gravity and movement properties accordingly and repurposes jump inputs for vertical swimming.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if Pippo in waterZone then Pippo.inWater = true setGravity(Pippo, reducedGravity) setDrag(Pippo, waterDrag) if Pippo.inWater then if keyPressed("up") then Pippo.velocity.y = -swimSpeed

Mechanic.Name: Flying
Mechanic.Description: Temporarily grants the ability to move freely in the air by reducing or disabling gravity, typically via a power-up.
Mechanic.ImplementationDetails: On activation, disables normal gravity and allows directional control. Reverts to normal physics when the power-up expires.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if flightPowerActive then disableGravity(Pippo) if keyPressed("up") then Pippo.velocity.y = -flySpeed if flightPowerExpired then enableGravity(Pippo)

Mechanic.Name: Environmental Movement Effects
Mechanic.Description: Adjusts Pippo’s movement based on environmental conditions such as wind, ice, or water currents.
Mechanic.ImplementationDetails: Checks Pippo’s current environment zone. Applies forces like constant acceleration for wind or reduced friction for ice to affect the movement trajectory.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if Pippo in windZone then Pippo.velocity.x += windForce if Pippo on ice then setFriction(Pippo, low)

Mechanic.Name: Time Manipulation for Platforming
Mechanic.Description: Allows Pippo to temporarily slow time, making it easier to perform precise maneuvers in challenging sequences.
Mechanic.ImplementationDetails: On activation via a designated power-up or input, adjusts the game’s time scale. Reverts back to normal after a limited duration with a cooldown period.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if timeManipulationActivated then setTimeScale(0.2) after(duration): setTimeScale(1)

Mechanic.Name: Stomp Attack
Mechanic.Description: Allows Pippo to defeat enemies by jumping on them, triggering enemy defeat and a bounce effect.
Mechanic.ImplementationDetails: Detects collision between Pippo’s downward movement and an enemy’s hitbox. Applies a bounce force upon successful enemy defeat.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if Pippo.velocity.y > 0 and detectCollision(Pippo.bottom, enemy.top) then defeat(enemy) Pippo.velocity.y = bounceForce

Mechanic.Name: Power-Up Combat
Mechanic.Description: Enables Pippo to acquire temporary combat advantages through power-ups, enhancing offensive or defensive capabilities.
Mechanic.ImplementationDetails: On collecting a power-up, temporarily modifies Pippo’s combat attributes for enhanced performance during enemy encounters.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if collision(Pippo, powerUp) then activatePowerUp(effect, duration) if powerUpActive then modifyCombatAttributes(Pippo)

Mechanic.Name: Damage and Invulnerability Frames
Mechanic.Description: Manages how Pippo receives damage and grants a brief period of invulnerability to prevent rapid successive hits.
Mechanic.ImplementationDetails: On taking damage from enemies or hazards, reduces Pippo’s life count and initiates a timer during which Pippo is immune to further damage.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: if collision(Pippo, enemy) then if not Pippo.invulnerable then Pippo.lives -= 1 Pippo.invulnerable = true startTimer(invulnerabilityDuration, function() { Pippo.invulnerable = false })

Mechanic.Name: Boss Combat Mechanics
Mechanic.Description: Defines multi-phase boss encounters with alternating attack, defense, and vulnerable states for challenging gameplay.
Mechanic.ImplementationDetails: Uses a state machine to control the boss's behavior, switching between attack, defense, and vulnerable phases, and applying damage when appropriate.
Mechanic.PseudoCode: switch(boss.state): case "attack": boss.performAttackPattern() case "defense": boss.reduceDamage() case "vulnerable": if Pippo.dealsDamage() then applyDamage(boss) if boss.health <= 0 then defeat(boss)

UIHUDSystems.Description: The interface layer displays game information such as lives, coins, power-ups and menus to guide and assist the player during gameplay.

SubSystem.Name: Main Menu
SubSystem.Description: Displays options including Start Game, Options, and Exit in an intuitive layout.

SubComponent.Name: Start Game Button
SubComponent.Description: Button that initiates the game, transitioning from menu to active play.
SubComponent.ImplementationDetails: On click or selection input, calls loadGameScene to begin gameplay. Changes visual state upon hover and click.
SubComponent.Interactions: Relies on the input system and scene manager to transition screens.

SubComponent.Name: Options Button
SubComponent.Description: Button to access and modify game settings including input bindings and audio/video preferences.
SubComponent.ImplementationDetails: Opens the settings menu overlay when clicked. Integrates with the custom input mapping system.
SubComponent.Interactions: Communicates with the Input Control and Audio Systems to reflect changes immediately.

SubComponent.Name: Exit Button
SubComponent.Description: Button that exits the game application.
SubComponent.ImplementationDetails: Triggers the shutdown routine when selected, ensuring all processes are safely terminated.
SubComponent.Interactions: Interacts with system-level commands to close the application.

SubSystem.Name: HUD
SubSystem.Description: Displays real-time in-game data such as lives, coins collected, active power-ups, and optionally a timer.

SubComponent.Name: Lives Indicator
SubComponent.Description: Graphical display showing remaining lives of Pippo.
SubComponent.ImplementationDetails: Dynamically updates as Pippo loses or gains extra lives. Uses icons or numbers as visual cues.
SubComponent.Interactions: Listens to gameplay events that change Pippo’s health state.

SubComponent.Name: Coin Counter
SubComponent.Description: Shows the number of coins collected in the current level.
SubComponent.ImplementationDetails: Increments on collision with coin objects. Updates the HUD immediately to reflect score changes.
SubComponent.Interactions: Directly linked to the Coin Collection and Scoring mechanic.

SubComponent.Name: Power-Up Display
SubComponent.Description: Visual indicator for current active power-ups along with their remaining durations.
SubComponent.ImplementationDetails: Activates when a power-up is collected. Uses icons with optional timers.
SubComponent.Interactions: Synchronizes with the Power-Up Mechanics to display current status and countdown.

SubComponent.Name: Timer
SubComponent.Description: Optional countdown or elapsed time display, used in time-trial sections or challenges.
SubComponent.ImplementationDetails: Starts when the level begins. Stops or resets when the level ends or is paused.
SubComponent.Interactions: Interacts with level progression and pause systems to ensure accuracy.

SubSystem.Name: Pause Menu
SubSystem.Description: Accessible during gameplay to resume, restart, adjust settings, or return to the main menu.

SubComponent.Name: Resume Button
SubComponent.Description: Returns the player to active gameplay from the paused state.
SubComponent.ImplementationDetails: Closes the pause overlay and restores the previous game state.
SubComponent.Interactions: Tied to the game loop to continue updates after pause.

SubComponent.Name: Restart Button
SubComponent.Description: Restarts the current level, resetting all necessary game states.
SubComponent.ImplementationDetails: Reloads level assets and resets scores, timers, and Pippo’s position.
SubComponent.Interactions: Communicates with the Level Loader to perform a full restart.

SubComponent.Name: Settings Button
SubComponent.Description: Opens the settings interface from within the pause menu.
SubComponent.ImplementationDetails: Invokes settings overlay, allowing modifications to controls, audio, and video.
SubComponent.Interactions: Interfaces with Input Control and Audio Systems for on-the-fly adjustments.

SubComponent.Name: Main Menu Button
SubComponent.Description: Exits the current game session and returns the player to the main menu.
SubComponent.ImplementationDetails: Triggers a scene transition from the current level to the main menu screen.
SubComponent.Interactions: Works with the scene manager to safely unload the level and prepare the main menu.

InputControlSystems.Description: Handles all user input and translates it into game actions using customizable controls and event-handling mechanisms.

SubSystem.Name: Movement Input
SubSystem.Description: Processes left/right movement through keyboard arrow keys or custom mappings.

SubComponent.Name: Key Polling
SubComponent.Description: Continuously checks for left/right key presses to update Pippo’s horizontal movement.
SubComponent.ImplementationDetails: Uses event polling to determine if the left or right keys are pressed. Normalizes and maps these actions to velocity changes.
SubComponent.Interactions: Directly affects Pippo’s basic horizontal movement mechanic and collision detection.

SubComponent.Name: Input Normalization
SubComponent.Description: Ensures that movement inputs are translated into a consistent velocity value.
SubComponent.ImplementationDetails: Converts raw key press values into predetermined speed vectors considering game settings such as multiplier effects.
SubComponent.Interactions: Works in conjunction with the game physics system to apply smooth movement.

SubSystem.Name: Jump Input
SubSystem.Description: Handles detecting jump actions via the spacebar and triggers physics-based vertical impulses.

SubComponent.Name: Jump Initiation
SubComponent.Description: Determines when a jump is started by detecting spacebar press and ensuring Pippo is eligible to jump.
SubComponent.ImplementationDetails: Checks if Pippo is on the ground or in an allowable state for double-jumping, and then applies the upward jump force.
SubComponent.Interactions: Relies on collision and physics systems to verify ground contact and apply jump buffering or cooldowns.

SubComponent.Name: Jump Buffering
SubComponent.Description: Allows the game to register jump input slightly before Pippo is ready, improving responsiveness.
SubComponent.ImplementationDetails: Implements a short time window where jump input is held and then executed the moment conditions become valid.
SubComponent.Interactions: Interacts with the physics system and jump mechanics to ensure smooth play experience.

SubSystem.Name: Custom Input Mapping
SubSystem.Description: Provides the functionality for players to remap keys for movement and jump actions via the options menu.

SubComponent.Name: Key Binding Storage
SubComponent.ImplementationDetails: Saves key mappings to a configuration file or local storage, and retrieves them on game startup.
SubComponent.Interactions: Works with the input system to override default key mappings.

SubComponent.Name: Runtime Update
SubComponent.Description: Applies new input mappings immediately during gameplay without restarting the game.
SubComponent.ImplementationDetails: Monitors options menu changes and updates the input event mappings in real-time.
SubComponent.Interactions: Directly feeds into the Movement and Jump Input sub-systems ensuring consistency.
